name: Kawana Misaki
source: Misaki is an upperclassman of [url=/c97354]Kouhei[/url] who lost her eyesight in an accident in elementary school. Despite her blindness, she has no wariness against other people, and has a sociable personality, being unreserved with everybody. She just graduated from high school and is trying to [spoiler]cope with the loss from the sudden disappearance of Kouhei[/spoiler].
